name: fig14_ensembles_finite_vs_gravitating
caption: (a) Heat capacity of finite two-level systems computed directly from the density of states (binomial degeneracies) and compared with the closed form; it is non-negative in the canonical ensemble. (b) For S(E) = 4 pi E^2 the exponent S(E) - beta E of the canonical integral has its stationary point at E = beta/(8 pi), which is a minimum (second derivative 8 pi > 0): the canonical integral does not converge as a dominated saddle and the canonical and microcanonical descriptions disagree (Planck units, k_B = 1).
